item_title: Sources: Palo Alto Networks is buying Cider Security for up to $300M
item_description: Ingrid Lunden / TechCrunch: Sources: Palo Alto Networks is buying Cider Security for up to $300M — More consolidation is afoot in the world of cyber security. TechCrunch has learned from sources that Palo Alto Networks is going to be announcing the acquisition of Cider Security for $200 million in cash and a further $100 million in shares.
